'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Steven Lewis LS Local Uprising''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steven Lewis]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title If I lose to Fear, I quit. Speeder counts Rebel Snowspeeder×7 / Snowspeeder×6 / Sandspeeder×4.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steven Lewis]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Local Uprising / Liberation|Local Uprising]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
